title: Cold plunges won’t save your deal.

content.text:
96

 Cold plunges won’t save your deal.
Hi Sara,
Here’s a weird trend I’ve noticed: the deeper someone is into buying a business, the more likely they are to be doing everything except improving their communication skills.
They’ve got the routine - early morning workouts, breathwork, even ice baths to boost resilience. 

But ask them how they plan to build trust with a seller? Crickets.
The irony? It’s rarely valuation that kills a deal. More often, it’s something softer but far more fatal: a breakdown in trust.
That’s why I brought Dana Garnett onto the Dealmakers Podcast. She’s a conflict strategist who works with buyers and sellers navigating the tricky emotional terrain behind small business sales, especially when personal relationships are baked into the business itself.
Dana’s approach is refreshingly direct. 
No woo-woo. No “just communicate better” fluff. 

Instead, she shows you how to identify trust fractures before they tank a deal and how to repair them when they start to show.
It’s not about becoming a master negotiator. It’s about getting to closing day without burning bridges or cortisol.
👉 Watch the episode on The Dealmakers Podcast here.
It might save your next deal and your nervous system. Ice baths are optional.
To smarter deals (and fewer stress-induced cold plunges),
Sara Sharp
Deal Attorney & Founder, Deal Academy
